desc: 台式蒸蛋机套图，白底主图到熟度阶梯与送礼收口
leaf: 台式速煮蒸蛋器（带蒸盘与量杯）
name: 一锅溏心速煮蒸蛋器款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用纯白底交代整机轮廓、透明顶盖与前脸一键，建立品类识别。
主图一秒法则：俯视平铺把一次出多枚的容量利益与丰盛早餐氛围一眼说清。
放大传统灶台水煮要盯火、易破壳、熟度不稳的焦虑，为下一镜的解法蓄势。
用双栏加勾叉位的对比结构，把新方式与传统水煮的差别一眼读出，主张全部留白。
让用户代入真实早餐台面，证明这台机器不止水煮，还能蒸蛋饼与多料。
机制解释：微距交代顶盖与不锈钢圈的咬合、一键面板与指示辉光，证明做工用料。
用三行熟度阶梯回答熟度能不能自己定，档位与时长一律留成空槽。
用空尺寸标注线与碗碟参照消除占地与收纳疑虑，规格数字全部留白。
把清洗这件麻烦事先解决掉，场景化交代配件可整体进洗碗机。
给出四种成品吃法供买家自选，扩大使用理由并顺势带出送礼场景。
清点随机器到手的每一件，消除少了什么的风险，价值感一次铺满。
以送礼场景收口，把下单理由落到具体人群与具体台面。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshot and contents screens, pale marble counter #F1ECE4 for benefit and scene screens, soft mint panel #E7F1EE as the curved headline band on infographic screens, deep charcoal field #24242A for the control macro and the stovetop pain screen, warm beech tabletop #C9A87C for the gift close; every screen is one flat material field with at most a single curved mint band, no gradient wash and no photographic scenery sitting behind infographic copy
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in the yolk-gold accent #F2B01E with signal-red hairlines #D8342B, rounded chips, empty circled tick and cross markers, curved arrow shapes carrying no lettering
style.lightingSystem: bright warm studio light around 5000K, soft front-left key with a #FFFFFF fill card, gentle contact shadows that always ground the piece, one skimming highlight sweeping along the transparent dome, no harsh speculars and no blown highlights on the clear lid
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm breakfast small-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of shell warm-white #FBF6EE, soft mint panel #E7F1EE, deep charcoal field #24242A and one yolk-gold accent #F2B01E on seamless studio white #FFFFFF; bright warm studio light around 5000K with a soft front-left key, a #FFFFFF fill card and one skimming highlight along the transparent dome; gentle contact shadows that always ground the piece; modern geometric sans-serif kept off the image so headline bands stay blank; consistent thin single-weight line icon style in yolk-gold with signal-red hairlines #D8342B; pale marble, matte cabinet and oiled beech material language; stable product scale and centring across every screen; blank spec chips, empty tick scales and empty callout slots instead of rendered copy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no invented specification numbers, counts or timings
style.presentationRules: the low round bowl body always sits level with its clear dome on top at one consistent scale across the set, shell eggs are the only food resting inside the appliance, the indicator reads as a plain unlabelled glow with no digits or readout, and no prop ever overlaps the front control face
style.surfaceSystem: pale marble counter #F1ECE4 with diagonal veining, white tiled splashback out of focus, matte cabinet interior #D8D5D0, brushed stainless dishwasher rack #AEB6BB, oiled beech tabletop #C9A87C
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held back for post-production only; all source headline and label copy is removed, so every headline band, label pill, tick scale and seal ring stays a blank empty shape with no lettering
